Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 
 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.
 

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

Your Role:
 

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Air Freight Administration
 

 
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
 
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
 
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities.  
 

Customer Service
 

 
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
 
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
 
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected.  
 

Compliance & Operational Excellence
 

 
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
 
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
 
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
 
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required.  
 

 
 

 

Your Profile:
 

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.
 

Requirements
 

 
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
 
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
 
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
 
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
 

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
 
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues. 
 

Personal Qualities
 

 
• Customer-focused and service-minded.
 
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
 
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
 
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
 
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Project description

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects within the process industry. You are fully accountable for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety across both new installations and major modifications to existing assets.

Primary Tasks & Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through commissioning and final handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget (including business case and investment approval) and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and site execution, commissioning, and handover to operations.
• Act as the single point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims, and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.

• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on command of MS Project, with ownership of planning rather than follow-up only.
• Academic working level combined with strong analytical skills and a helicopter view.

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You bring strong leadership skills and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate effectively with stakeholders at every organisational level.

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Main missions:
 
 

• Support for customers for technical questions about existing or future products and/or services mainly in the residential segment. 

• Preparation of pre-design and material lists for drawing up quotations 

• Informing customers proactively about product changes 

• Maintain network technical contact points at customers 

• Building up knowledge about existing and new products and solutions 

• Internal contact point for product knowledge 

• Proactively communicate new items/innovations within the product portfolio for the BU Residential. 

• Offer support in the realization of residential projects (kick-off meeting, analysis of specifications, proposal, planning, etc.). 

• Provide training and support/back up for the Solar Academy training courses 

• Preparation of complex quotations 

• Management of technical files in SalesForce 

Requirements
 
 

• A master’s degree in Electro-technics, civil or industrial engineering or similar qualifications 

• Residing in Belgium 

• Minimum 2 years experience in a technical environment 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. Good knowledge of French, German is a plus 

• Stress resistant 

• Great team player 

• Customer-centric attitude

jobs.occupation: Sales Advisor Toyota City / Lexus Zaventem
jobs.description:
About us

Inchcape is the leading global automotive distributor operating in +40 markets. We partner with some of the biggest brands in the business to sustainably power better mobility today and in the future.

Our diverse global team of over 16,000 talented colleagues foster an inclusive and collaborative culture, delivering a brilliant experience for our customers and partners. We're a dynamic and fast-growing business, driving the transformation of our industry and redefining tomorrow.

Inchcape Belux employs over 250 team members. Our portfolio includes vehicle distribution for world-renowned brands, market leading fulfilment solutions, exceptional retail experiences, and tailored financial services.

 

Do you want to develop world-class skills, build a brilliant career, and thrive within a highly supportive team? Join Inchcape Belux, part of Inchcape's global network.

You'll play a key role in delivering outstanding customer experiences while representing one of the world's most trusted automotive brands. You'll be part of a dynamic team where collaboration, performance, and customer satisfaction are central.

Our Toyota City Zaventem team is looking for a Sales Advisor New Cars to support the sales of new Toyota and Lexus vehicles. In this role, you will guide customers throughout their buying journey, actively manage leads, and ensure a seamless and professional sales experience.

What you'll do
 
• Drive showroom sales for both B2B and B2C customers. 
• Actively prospect and develop new fleet clients while ensuring close follow‑up of all B2B and B2C leads. 
• Handle daily leads in line with brand standards and deliver strong performance on mystery leads, emails, calls, visits, and test drives. 
• Deliver excellent customer experience by informing, advising, and following up professionally, building long‑term trust and satisfaction. 
• Act as a Toyota Brand Ambassador in the showroom, during events, and on social media, with a polished appearance and courteous behaviour. 
• Apply Toyota's Omotenashi principles to create a warm, personalised customer experience. 
• Ensure flawless test drives and a smooth, high‑quality delivery process for customers. 
• Upsell additional products and services such as financing, insurance, and accessories. 
• Complete all administrative tasks accurately and in line with internal procedures. 
• Contribute to high customer recommendation and online reputation scores by consistently delivering top‑tier service. 
 

 

About you

To be successful in this role you will be:
 
• Passionate about the automotive industry and eager to build a career in sales. 
• Results‑driven and proactive, motivated to seize every sales opportunity. 
• Experienced in a customer‑facing role where customer satisfaction was the top priority. 
• Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment. 
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good knowledge of English.

Team/division description:

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation within P&I). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.

At P&I we strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.

Your responsibilities

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.

 
• 
HR Data Governance & Data Quality

 
• 
Business Analysis within HR Data Domain

 
• 
Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team

 
• 
Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)

 
• 
Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)

 
• 
Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)

 
• 
Monitoring testing and release management

 
• 
Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed

Your profile:

 
• 
English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.

 
• 
Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role

 
• 
Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset

 
• 
Stakeholder Management

 
• 
Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors

 
• 
Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.

 
• 
Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams

 
• 
The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.

 
• 
Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.
